title.narrative: Conducting dialysis for Syrian refugees with kidney failure in Lebanon.

description.narrative: 100 Syrian kidney failure patients who hold an asylum number inside Lebanon will receive from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees the names and hospitals assigned to treat each patient according to their registration number.
Providing dialysis services through hospitals and specialized centers for Syrian refugees in Lebanon, including transporting them to and from their residence.
Providing therapeutic dialysis services for kidney failure/saving the lives of kidney failure patients by providing the appropriate service/reducing the burden on the Syrian refugee family in Lebanon
